content.value: What is symmetric matrix? Find all values of a, b, and c for which A is symmetric.

$$
\pmb { \mathrm { A } } = \left[ \begin{array} { c c c } { 2 } & { \mathbf { a } - 2 \mathbf { b } + 2 \mathbf { c } } & { 2 \mathbf { a } + \mathbf { b } + \mathbf { c } } \\ { 3 } & { 5 } & { \mathbf { a } + \mathbf { c } } \\ { 0 \cdot } & { \cdot 2 } & { 7 } \end{array} \right]
$$
